en.headline: Christie’s opens commemorative show of 1935 Chinese art exhibition
en.dek: Nearly 15 masterpieces that appeared in the landmark Royal Academy display are on view at The Henderson in Central until 6 November.
body: Christie’s Hong Kong opened a free public exhibition on Thursday that revisits the 1935–36 Royal Academy International Exhibition of Chinese Art in London.

The show, titled “The Royal Academy International Exhibition of Chinese Art 1935–36: A Commemorative Tribute,” runs until 6 November at Christie’s Asia Pacific headquarters at The Henderson, 2 Murray Road, Central.

It brings together nearly 15 masterpieces across a range of collecting categories, all of which were exhibited in the original London display. The works are shown alongside the launch of a new six-volume scholarly publication, “1935 The International Exhibition of Chinese Art,” authored by Regina Krahl and Sarah Wong and published by Daniel Eskenazi.

Among the pieces is an imperial early Ming cinnabar lacquer phoenix bowlstand bearing a Yongle mark and of the period, with a gilt inscription composed by the Qianlong Emperor in 1781. It was formerly in the collection of Sir Percival David.
The exhibition is open to the public during Hong Kong Asian Art Week and occupies a different floor of The Henderson from the house’s autumn Asian art auction previews.

zh.headline: 佳士得展開1935年中國藝術展覽紀念展
zh.dek: 近15件曾於倫敦皇家藝術學院展出的精品，即日起至11月6日於中環The Henderson公開展出。
body: 佳士得香港周四起公開展出「英國皇家藝術學院『1935–36中國藝術國際展覽會』：紀念獻禮」，重溫90年前於倫敦舉行的歷史性展覽。
展覽至11月6日止，地點為中環美利道2號The Henderson佳士得亞太區總部，期間免費向公眾開放。
展出近15件精品，涵蓋多個收藏範疇，全部曾於1935至36年倫敦原展亮相。同時推出由Regina Krahl及Sarah Wong撰寫、Daniel Eskenazi出版的六卷本學術著作《1935 The International Exhibition of Chinese Art》。
其中一件為明永樂年間朱漆鳳紋盞托，帶乾隆皇帝1781年御製金書題識，原屬大維德爵士舊藏。
展覽與佳士得亞洲藝術週秋季拍賣預展同期舉行，但位於同一大廈不同樓層。
